info.name: Ankheg Plate
info.description: The construction for my custom Ankheg Plate.
info.author: Gustavo Schip

description.p: This plate armor has been expertly crafted. Sheathed in the chitinous scales of the ankheg, it provides a greater degree of protection than traditional plate armor and is not susceptible to rust. As any world-weary adventurer will tell you, however, the best appreciated aspect of ankheg plate is its light weight and low encumbrance. Monsters come and go, but fatigue is a constant enemy.
